summary.content:
Today's selection covers 55 articles from 8 trusted sources, including 37 on Artificial Intelligence and 7 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: Anthropic warns infostealer malware is hijacking Claude sessions to drain usage
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Anthropic, Microsoft
• **Security Alert**: Texas Governor Abbott blocks funding for more Flock cameras
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, data breaches, malware
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from BleepingComputer, The Verge, TechCrunch, Dark Reading, NY Times Tech and others
• **Fresh Content**: 10 articles published in the last 24 hours
